The '''Bormea/Darpa Corridor''' was a segment of the [[Perlemian Trade Route/Legends|Perlemian Trade Route]] in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]]. The Corridor covered the wealthiest worlds of the Route: [[Corulag/Legends|Corulag]], [[Chandrila/Legends|Chandrila]], [[Brentaal IV/Legends|Brentaal IV]], [[Esseles/Legends|Esseles]], [[Rhinnal/Legends|Rhinnal]], and [[Ralltiir/Legends|Ralltiir]].<ref>''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>
